faqs.question: What is token burning?
faqs.answer: Token burning permanently removes tokens from circulation by sending them to an unusable address. This creates deflationary pressure and may increase scarcity value.

faqs.question: How does ETH burning work?
faqs.answer: Since EIP-1559, base fees are burned instead of going to miners. During high activity, ETH can become deflationary. Track burn rates on ultrasound.money.

faqs.question: Which projects have significant burns?
faqs.answer: Ethereum (base fees), BNB (quarterly burns), SHIB (community burns), and many protocols with buy-and-burn mechanisms. Check tokenomics to understand burn schedules.
